title: Irrigation Water Budget vs Rainfall
dataSources: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), sump pump (`sumppump:event`), well pump (`wellpump:event`), pool/spa chemistry (`pool:chemistry`), water softener (`watersoftener:status`), irrigation zones (`irrigation:zone`).
app: Smart water meters (Flume / Flo / HomeWizard), sump- and well-pump sensors, pool/spa controllers, water-softener and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=irrigation:zone
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(water_l) as irrigated_l by _time
| eval budget_l=6000, over_budget=if(irrigated_l>budget_l,1,0)
| sort - _time
description: Compares how much water your garden irrigation used each week against a target budget so watering stays generous but not wasteful.
value: Irrigation is easy to over-do; a weekly water budget keeps the garden healthy while curbing the biggest avoidable water expense.
implementation: Ingest irrigation volumes; schedule weekly and compare usage to your water budget.
visualization: Column chart of weekly irrigation volume against a budget line.
grandmaExplanation: It compares how much water the garden sprinklers use each week to a sensible target, so you do not overwater.
